tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, bottom panel, sidebar and sheets.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Second card fill: rows inside a sheet, selected tab, switch track, inset blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons; the idle connect ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and hints, 12px and up.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, connected ring, radio dot, switch track when on.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill (black on red, 5.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text or a thin icon on a surface: active tab, spinner, error ring.

tokens.name: gray-layer
tokens.usage: Second layer of the Veil mark (gray).

tokens.name: veil-light
tokens.usage: Overlap of the two layers in the Veil mark.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Protected dot and positive traffic deltas; always paired with a word or a triangle.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind sheets and dialogs, at 78% (dark) or 55% (light).

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: Hardware: bezels, Dynamic Island, cameras. Not UI.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Montserrat 600 for headings, 500 for body. Nothing below 12px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Server name in the bottom panel, desktop page titles at 24px.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Arial-metric face for numbers that tick.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Title to subtitle.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row and screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop content padding.

radius.note: Flat cards; the ring and switches are circles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav items, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Ring, switch, status dot.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Primary button and segmented control.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Connect ring on phones (150 tight, 232 on desktop).

shadow.note: One elevation, used only for desktop dialogs and the menu bar popover.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers that overlap other content.
